'''2007 Worlds Day 1 Jeffrey Johns LS An Unusual Amount of Fear''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jeffrey Johns]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jeffrey Johns]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
